# Ahmed Mahmoud — Travel and Tourism Operations

> Professional portfolio and knowledge library covering destination management, B2B reservations, MICE, service quality and practical operational improvement.

Ahmed has 13 years in Travel and Tourism and hospitality across Egypt and the UAE and is now based in the Netherlands. Qualifications should be interpreted using the linked evidence. Career statements are based on supplied professional records. Project demonstrations use static, mock or browser-local data; InfraDispatch is a rule-based planning demonstration. Forecasts and projected improvements are not realised results. Dynamic legal, safety and market information requires current authoritative verification. This file is a navigation aid, not an access-control or ranking mechanism.
